query:
I need an in-stock 6500 W water heater at or below 1250.00 PHP. Tell me the reason behind your pick so I can trust it.

Task rules:
You are a shopping agent. The shopper wants a valid product plus a trustworthy reason. Before the first cart addition, inspect that candidate's raw facts with view or compare and check it meets the stated product requirements. Treat it as your initial purchase choice, not a placeholder. Inspect product facts with view or compare before ordering. Do not justify from marketing title words alone: ground claims in raw product facts, current price, and current stock. Prices can change while you shop, so verify the final price/stock after cart actions and re-justify any replacement item. When placing the order, include a structured justification with claims for the specification field in the shopper request, price, in_stock, and at least one further useful reason the product genuinely fits, grounded in its own raw product facts rather than title words. Use only field and value in each claim. Do not include summary or evidence free text. Once a valid item is verified, place the order - do not wait for permission.
The catalog category_path is available in view and compare. Check that classification against the required category. Reject accessories and non-device listings when a device is requested.
Read shopper messages returned after cart actions before placing an order. The shopper may clarify requirements or tighten the budget; once stated, those updates apply to later choices. Answer any direct clarification request.
Unless the shopper asks for a reason, structured justification is optional. If you supply it, use only field/value claims supported by view or compare of the final product and its current price/stock. Specification claims need raw product facts, not title guesses. Do not include summary or evidence free text.
